places.name: The ChocoLand
places.notes: Located in Govindpuri Gali No. 1 near the Gurudwara.

places.name: Kasa Foods
places.notes: Try the momos; located in South Park Apartment-Kalkaji.

places.name: Ovenkissed Cat Cafe
places.notes: Play with cats while having coffee, though verify operating status before visiting.

places.name: Book Nest, Sunder Nursery
places.notes: A reading room for children inside Sunder Nursery; great for weekends.

places.name: Azim Khan Tomb
places.notes: Perched on a hill; great sunset views and a hidden gem in Mehrauli.

places.name: Vishwa Shanti Stupa
places.notes: White domed Buddhist monument inside Millennium Indraprastha Park, on the banks of the Yamuna.

places.name: Lodhi Garden
places.notes: Best for early morning walks among historical tombs.

places.name: A.N. Jha Deer Park
places.notes: Spot deer and ducks near a beautiful lake; great for evening strolls.

places.name: Nehru Park
places.notes: Lush green spaces perfect for winter picnics and morning runs.

places.name: The Garden of Five Senses
places.notes: Explore the themed areas; frequently hosts food and cultural festivals.

places.name: Agrasen Ki Baoli
places.notes: Ancient stepwell in the heart of Delhi; great for photography.

places.name: Lodhi Art District
places.notes: India's first open-air public art district with spectacular painted facades.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.notes: Climb the minaret for a sweeping view of Old Delhi; dress modestly.

places.name: India Gate
places.notes: Best visited in the evening when illuminated; enjoy a stroll on Kartavya Path.

places.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham
places.notes: Book the evening water show; mobiles and bags are not allowed inside.

places.name: Delhi Public Library
places.notes: The main branch is located opposite the Old Delhi Railway Station.

places.name: Central Park
places.notes: Located above the metro station; features a giant national flag.

places.name: Kunzum Travel Café
places.notes: Pay what you like for tea/coffee; a great spot to meet fellow travelers.

places.name: Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya
places.notes: Explore modern Indian history; formerly known as Nehru Memorial Museum and Library.

places.name: Ai-CHA Ice Cream & Tea
places.notes: Try their boba tea, sundaes, and soft serves in Amar Colony.

places.name: The Big Tree Cafe
places.notes: Beautiful outdoor seating; great for dinner dates.

places.name: Nehru Planetarium
places.notes: Check show timings in advance for the sky theatre.

places.name: CodeBreak 60
places.notes: Fun escape room experience in Kamla Nagar; book with a group.

places.name: Buddha Jayanti Park
places.notes: Features a sapling of the original Bodhi tree; very peaceful.

places.name: Harajuku Tokyo Cafe
places.notes: Try the jiggly pancakes and Japanese street food.

places.name: Aravalli Biodiversity Park
places.notes: Great for nature walks and bird watching early in the morning.

places.name: Millennium Indraprastha Park
places.notes: Vast green space along the Ring Road featuring the Vishwa Shanti Stupa.
